description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into a Zoho CRM module via the native Upsert Records API. `POST /crm/{version}/{module_api_name}/upsert` atomically creates or updates, matching on duplicate_check_fields -- no search-then-write. Chunks internally at Zoho's 100-records-per-request limit.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Zoho CRM record (upserted via duplicate_check_fields).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / rows_skipped_no_key). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Zoho CRM.

module_api_name.label: Module Api Name
module_api_name.description: Target Zoho CRM module API name (Leads / Contacts / Accounts / Deals / custom).

duplicate_check_fields.label: Duplicate Check Fields
duplicate_check_fields.description: Zoho field API names used to detect duplicates on upsert (e.g. ['Email']). Must be a subset of fields_map values.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column → Zoho field API name.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). Always chunked at Zoho's 100-records-per-request limit internally.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter the rows to send to the current date partition key.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter the rows to send to the current static partition value.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`. Shapes: {kind: sql, resource_key/database_url_env_var, query}, {kind: csv, path, read_csv_kwargs}, {kind: inline, rows}.

name: Zoho CRM Record Upsert
